slides.title: Joint Range of Motion
slides.english_text:
Joint Range of Motion
• the distance and direction a joint can move between the flexed position and the extended position
• Each specific joint has a normal range of motion that is expressed in degrees.
• Devices used for measuring ROM: goniometer, inclinometer
• AROM: active range of motion
• Patient moves the joint
• AROM
actively without any
assistance
• PROM: passive range of motion
• PROM
• Therapist moves the joint through the range of motion with no effort from the patient

slides.title: AROM Summary
slides.english_text:
AROM Summary
Each joint has a normal ROM range of values, while each person has a different amount of ability to achieve it.
Below are generally accepted values for a normal ROM for some joints as measured in degrees:
Normal AROM
Hip Flexion
Hip Extension
Hip Abduction
Hip Internal rotation
Hip External rotation
Knee Flexion
Knee Extension
Shoulder Flexion
Shoulder Extension
Shoulder Abduction
Shoulder Internal rotation
Shoulder External rotation
Elbow Flexion
Elbow Extension
slides.raw_bilingual_text:
AROM Summary 主動活動幅度摘要
Each joint has a normal ROM range of values, while each person has a different amount of ability to achieve it.
每個關節都有一個正常的活動幅度（ROM）值，而每個人達到此幅度的能力各不相同。
